description: Content that mentions, recommends, or favorably compares competitor products or services. This includes direct competitor names, competitor product names, or suggestions to use competitor offerings instead of our products.
examples: You should try Google Cloud instead, it's better
AWS offers a similar service called Lambda
Microsoft Azure has a competing product
I recommend switching to Competitor Corp's solution
Their pricing is better than ours at $5/month
counter_examples: Our product supports integration with multiple cloud providers
This feature is unique to our platform
Our solution outperforms alternatives in benchmark tests
Industry analysts rate our product highly
